title: Write the dispatch schedule and the gear order
purpose: Every new site gets its phones, people, and gear on a named day, from inventory that really exists.
with: Moharam for the start date and the quota, Mazen for the gear, Mano for the numbers
when: After the site visit, once the site plan is in, and again whenever phones or people come free.
needs: The site plan from the visit
The dashboard with last night's numbers

steps.do: Read the site plan and write what the site needs
steps.detail: Phones, one operator per ten phones, a ten percent bench, ten percent spares, the upload path, and the shift pattern.
steps.check: One number for phones, people, and spares.

steps.time: The morning after the daily report
steps.detail: How many floors are active, when each project ends, and which phones and people come free.
steps.check: You know what is free and when.

steps.do: Run the calculator with Mano and Moharam
steps.detail: Phones, operators, reviewers, hubs, and internet speed for the hours the site will record.
steps.check: Nothing is short. If it is, the date waits.

steps.do: Pick the phones by device number and the people by name
steps.detail: From inventory that exists today, never from another site's kit.
steps.check: Every phone and every person is named.

steps.do: Set the upload path and the start date with Moharam
steps.detail: The site's own wireless internet, if it passed the test, or the closest hub. Moharam agrees the daily hour quota.
steps.check: Moharam said yes to the date and the quota.

steps.do: Write the dispatch schedule and the gear order
steps.detail: Which phones leave the store on which day, who goes where, and what Mazen has to provide.
steps.check: Every line has a day and a name.

steps.do: Send the order to Mazen and the schedule to everyone
steps.detail: Mazen and Mano get the order. Moharam, Mazen, Mano, and the Portfolio Manager get the schedule.

steps.do: Put the site on the dashboard and keep the schedule true
steps.detail: The site with its quota and start date. When something moves, rewrite the lines that changed and resend them.
steps.check: The dashboard and the schedule say the same thing.

done: Moharam agreed the date and quota. Mazen confirmed the handover day. Everyone has the schedule. The site is on the dashboard.

fails.then: The date waits. Mazen orders through Mano. Mano opens hiring. Tell Moharam the same day.

fails.if: The dashboard disagrees with the floor
fails.then: Do not write a schedule on a number you do not trust. Tell Mano the same day.

fails.if: Mazen cannot fill the order by the day
fails.then: Launch day moves. No site launches short.

fails.if: The closest hub has no room
fails.then: Send the runs to the second hub and tell Mano. Two nights over 70 percent means the next hub search starts.

fails.if: Phones or people move after the schedule went out
fails.then: Rewrite the lines that changed that night and resend them.

escalate: Moharam the same day for the date or the people. Mano the same day for the order, a hub, or a wrong number.
